descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S25 Network drops with the dashboard open: a clear no-network message, then the counts catch up without a reload

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 When a TC-20 action fails, the screens say so instead of looking current. If note generation fails (main and backup model), the chart shows 'Note not generated' with the dictation kept and the dashbo … (UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5; UAT OAT-03)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Standard fixture. Dashboard open in context A; a second client (context B) on the same account

When Take context A offline (context.setOffline(true); if that does not drop the Convex WebSocket, close it with page.routeWebSocket). From B, move the patient from pending to pre-rounded. Wait 10 s, then bring A back online. Both care settings

Then While offline, A shows a clear 'no network' message, or at least does not present its counts as current. After reconnect, A's counts and row catch up to B's write without a reload

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT Empty & Failure States ('Offline / no network: clear "no network" message'), OAT-03. Offline checkpoint: 'no network' shown (UAT wording, matched case-insensitively). Reconnect checkpoint: Pending 0, In Progress 1 within the step's expect timeout (Q8 gives no limit), with no reload in A

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S25

Network drops with the dashboard open: a clear no-network message, then the counts catch up without a reload

Tickets: none (UAT only)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (newspec-c/plan.json, automatable: yes): New Playwright spec per care setting: fresh account, one pending patient / In Today resident. Context A on the dashboard goes offline (context.setOffline(true)); first check the Convex socket really dropped. Context B types the pre-round text and Save Note (parse answered at B's socket so the status change is deterministic; B is online). After 10 s A must show the 'no network' banner and A's counts must not have moved. A back online: counts catch up (Pending 0, In Progress 1) without a reload. — setOffline + a second context; the banner and counters are DOM reads.

Detail:

Both care settings pass (rounding 4 runs, snf 5 runs; failures seen only from backend overload or a dev-server page reload, both fixed/excluded). A offline (setOffline + Convex socket cut; setOffline alone did not close the open socket): banner 'No network connection. What you dictate stays on this screen…', counts held at Pending 1; B's pre-round Save Note moved the chart; after reconnect A shows Pending 0 / In Progress 1 within 0.1-3.8 s, no reload, banner gone.

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A: the step to write is a scripted Playwright spec in tools/qa-agent that makes its own fresh accounts and takes one of two contexts offline (fault-offline); dev has one shared account, no admin key and no action or socket mock (runner-contract §10), so it runs on the local stack only.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
